$comment: Known high/critical npm advisories that are deliberately left in the tree, and why (#337). Read by scripts/ci/npm-audit-gate.mjs. Every entry needs a reason; an entry that stops matching fails CI so it is removed. Never add one to make CI green without saying what would have to change for it to be fixed.

accepted.reason: No fixed braces exists (3.0.3 is the latest release and is in the vulnerable range). It reaches the tree only through eslint-config-next -> @next/eslint-plugin-next -> fast-glob@3.3.1 -> micromatch, a devDependency used by `npm run lint` on glob patterns written in this repository; it is not in the production bundle and never sees user input. npm's offered fix is eslint-config-next@14.2.35, a two-major downgrade that drops the next@16 rules, so it is not taken.
accepted.revisit: When braces publishes a fixed release (then pin it with `overrides`) or @next/eslint-plugin-next stops depending on fast-glob@3.3.1.
